goal: Organize repository navigation, runtime-output boundaries, and local hygiene without disrupting contract-bound evidence or existing working changes.
acceptance_criteria: A current repository guide defines the purpose and retention rule for every top-level area without moving contract-bound evidence.
A deterministic read-only hygiene check detects prohibited root caches, live CGKN support state under examples, and missing runtime ignore boundaries.
Management validation and applicable repository-hygiene tests pass.
Only verified untracked and reproducible cache or temporary directories are removed; tracked evidence and unrelated working changes are preserved.
README navigation reflects plugins, tools, project management, formal evidence, runtime outputs, and legacy boundaries.
The small-scale plugin smoke run is retained under artifacts rather than presented as a reviewed example project.

quality_metrics.measure: CGKN uses the same method it exposes

prevention: Confirm acceptance, interfaces, and applicable kernel constraints before implementation.
assurance: Review method, schema, skill, and repository instruction consistency.

control: Run targeted kernel and knowledge tests.

feedback: Repository navigation, output boundaries, and hygiene checks now pass without moving referenced historical evidence or altering the reviewed generation and delivery routes.

worked: A retention map plus a read-only hygiene checker made cleanup reviewable and repeatable.
did_not_work: A single combined recursive cleanup command was rejected by the execution safety policy and had to be split into validation, move, and exact ignored-path cleanup steps.
experiments: On the next three iterations, retain only concise tracked evidence summaries while keeping bulky run output under ignored artifacts or runs paths.
